mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as capital costs decline across the corporate sector.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% signals aggressive monetary easing, triggering immediate liquidity-driven S&P 500 rallies within 5 trading days as investors shift to risk assets.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS < 0.1% for 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise indicate accommodative policy amid inflation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as markets price stabilization.
failure_condition: Interaction effect fails: Rank IC < 0.03 or positive returns < 55% in 60-day windows with FEDFUNDS↓ and CPIAUCSL↑.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 5.0%), rising PAYEMS growth signals labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days via improved consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative in >55% of UNRATE < 5.0% periods with PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained PAYEMS growth (>0.5% monthly) indicates strong labor market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days through immediate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: 5-day returns negative in >55% of months with PAYEMS growth > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1,100,000 units annually signals robust housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days via construction sector spillovers and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 60-day returns negative in >55% of HOUST > 1100.0 periods.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 450,000 million), INDPRO decline signals manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days via earnings revision risks.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive in >55% of RSAFS > 450000.0 periods with INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing output, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate earnings growth accelerates across supply chains.
failure_condition: 60-day returns negative in >55% of INDPRO > 105.0 periods (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).
